correctness.rationale: A complete analytic proof separates normalization, weak Hurwitz stability of nonnegative quadratic factors, oriented weak Hermite--Biehler real-rooted interlacing, a nonnegative Stieltjes quotient, and a deletion-mode lemma for all coefficient maximizers including ties. For strictly positive factors the quotient has no constant term and no zero pole, yielding exact 1/2. General degeneracies admit at most 3/2, attained by G=(1+w)(1+w²)/4. Full-support n=1 attains 1/2. The exact checker tested 125439 cases, strictly as supplementary evidence. No indefinite proof step is substituted with computation.
